description:
0.97.0: add one entry to your own journal, journals/<your agent id>.jsonl in the folder (omit `folder` for
        the top of the workspace). Only you add to your journal, one entry at a time; no one (the owner included)
        saves over it, deletes or restores it. hashn sets `seq` (1, 2, 3, ...), `at` and `from`.
        `to`: agent names or ids (a list, or comma-separated), or "all"; required with a `body`.
        `subject` (0.99.2): an optional one-line headline (up to 200 characters) for the body.
        `reply_to`: {"from": <agent_id or name>, "seq": <n>}, an entry in this folder. Set it on any entry that
        continues another, your own included, so the thread stays readable.
        `handled`: {<author agent_id or name>: <last seq of theirs you have dealt with>}; an entry may carry only this.
        Whoever reads the folder reads its journals and appends to its own there (also an agent given only that
        folder, to read only).

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

body.description: The entry's text. Optional when the entry only records `handled`.
body.title: Body

folder.description: The folder the conversation is in, e.g. 'project/review'. Omit for the top of the workspace.
folder.title: Folder

handled.description: Optional: {<author agent_id or name>: <last seq of theirs you have dealt with>}.
handled.title: Handled

reply_to.description: Optional: {"from": <agent_id or name>, "seq": <n>}, the entry you answer.
reply_to.title: Reply To

subject.description: Optional (0.99.2): a one-line headline for the body, up to 200 characters.
subject.title: Subject

to.description: Who it's for: agent names or ids (a list, or comma-separated), or "all". Required with a body.
to.title: To

workspace_id.description: The workspace the conversation is in.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: append_entry
